expected_jd_text:
ProphetX is a prediction market focused on sports, aiming to power America's next great asset class through sports event contracts. They are seeking a Mobile QA Engineer to own mobile testing activities, ensuring quality across their iOS and Android applications in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities
Own and lead mobile QA testing across iOS and Android platforms
Design, write, and maintain comprehensive test cases and test plans for new and existing features
Execute thorough regression testing cycles to ensure platform stability across releases
Validate new features during active development in close collaboration with product and engineering
Serve as the primary quality gatekeeper for mobile releases, ensuring each build meets quality standards before it ships
Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps and severity assessments
Collaborate with the Vietnam-based QA and engineering teams to maintain quality alignment across time zones to ensure sufficient coverage
Contribute to and help grow our mobile automation framework as time and capacity allow

Qualification

Required
Strong hands-on experience with manual testing on iOS and Android applications
Proven ability to write detailed, well-structured test cases and test plans
Experience executing and managing regression test suites for mobile applications
Familiarity with mobile-specific testing considerations: device fragmentation, OS versions, performance, network conditions and proxy tools such as Proxyman
Experience with bug tracking tools (e.g. Jira) and test management platforms such as TestRail or BrowserStack
Comfortable working in fast moving Agile/Scrum environments with regular release cadences
Direct QA or testing experience in the betting, gambling, sportsbook, or betting exchange domain is required
Strong understanding of betting concepts such as markets, odds, events, and settlements
Experience testing user wallets, balances, and financial transaction flows
Familiarity with risk-sensitive and revenue-impacting user flows
Exposure to compliance-driven or regulated environments is a plus, especially US-facing products
Practical or working familiarity with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Copilot) to assist in test case generation or coverage analysis
Openness to leveraging AI tooling to improve testing efficiency and output quality
Interest in staying current with emerging AI-powered QA tools and techniques

Preferred
Experience with mobile test automation frameworks (e.g. Appium, XCUITest, Espresso, or similar)
Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
Background in fintech or real-money transaction testing

Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible time off built on trust and accountability
